_comment: Golden fixtures: group naming (landed) and the three M3 stubs (PLAN-metalstorm-command-language.md §1, §7). The camera / ui / query kinds validate NOW and refuse NOW — an envelope for a port that doesn't exist yet must produce a visible 'not yet supported', never a silent success. When M3 injects the ports these same fixtures start asserting real calls.

fixtures.name: rename a group
fixtures.note: Rides the OrgGroup UPDATE case that has existed on the wire all along (empty add/remove + a name is a pure rename) — no server change, and the index picks the new name up on the next snapshot.

fixtures.name: rename resolves the group strictly
fixtures.note: A rename is as destructive as an order — renaming the wrong squad makes every later sentence address the wrong one. Same strict rule, same question.

fixtures.name: creating a group from a sentence is refused, not faked
fixtures.utterance: make a new squad called Hammerfall
fixtures.note: §5: never auto-form. Forming a group costs authority and interacts with AI asset locks, and there is no unit-name index to resolve memberRefs against. Refused with the org-panel workaround named.

fixtures.name: camera focus is a valid envelope with no port yet
camera follow
fixtures.utterance: keep the camera on Chimera Squad

fixtures.name: ui fullscreen — the minimap panel doesn't exist yet either
fixtures.utterance: show me the minimap, full screen
fixtures.note: A plan §0 example utterance. Minimap fullscreen is BUILT in M3; until then the envelope is well-formed and the refusal names the missing port.

fixtures.name: count query
fixtures.utterance: how many heavy tanks do we have left?
fixtures.note: A plan §0 example utterance. The query engine is M3 and is LOS-honest by construction; asking is never an order, so nothing is sent either way.

fixtures.name: resources query
fixtures.utterance: how are we doing on authority?

fixtures.name: objectives query
fixtures.utterance: what are we supposed to be doing?
